decisions.reason: As a low-cost complementary care product that gained its own page in 2024, it appears to be a promising extension whose option value still exceeds its carrying cost.
This maintenance-oil line fits the installed base of wood floors and is cheap to keep available, so despite only modest web prominence the firm would likely continue to test demand.
Because it directly supports oiled wood floors and was upgraded to its own page in 2024, the product line looks valuable enough to retain while the firm builds recurring aftercare sales.
The underlay with moisture protection is strategically adjacent and inexpensive to keep in the assortment, so management is more likely to preserve this option unless sales clearly disappoint.
This underlay foam is somewhat more at risk because it is a less differentiated accessory that stayed only mentioned on the website, but its low carrying cost still favors keeping it for now.

Although a multi-model parquet line ties up more resources than care accessories, it is close to the core flooring business and consistent with the firm's growth strategy, so the firm would likely keep it absent clearer negative evidence.
